name: Camila
self_text: Hey there! I’m Camila, a mid‑30s non‑binary American who loves chasing fresh angles with my Canon. I’m on the hunt for a quick, fast‑paced practice session where we can focus on some specific shots—no gear debates or post‑processing lessons this time. I’m all about keeping the energy up and making the most of our time together. Saturday afternoons are my sweet spot, so that’s when I’m free to dive into a session and get those compositions nailed. I’m a fan of running trails, so I appreciate a bit of movement and outdoor vibes. If you’re up for a lively, no‑frills shoot that keeps the momentum going, let’s connect and capture something great!
